Mount on the regulator station housing beside the heater coil, facing the technician who removes the element.
The heater coil in a gas regulator station can stay hot long after power is removed. Handling the element before it cools could press hot metal against bare skin and cause a burn.
WARNING Clarifier Launder Cover Sign – Removed Cover Exposes Open Water – 8x12 Aluminum
CLARIFIER LAUNDER COVER / REMOVED COVER EXPOSES OPEN WATER / BARRICADE THE UNCOVERED SECTION / KEEP OFF ADJACENT LOOSE PANELS
Mount on the clarifier handrail beside the launder cover opening.
With the cover removed, the open water section can drop a person into the launder.
WARNING Dosing Pump Pulse Dampener Sign – Trapped Liquid Can Spray – 8x12 Aluminum
DOSING PUMP PULSE DAMPENER / TRAPPED LIQUID CAN SPRAY / ISOLATE AND VERIFY DEPRESSURIZED / BEFORE REMOVING DAMPENER CAP
Post on the dosing pump skid frame near the pulse dampener, facing the technician who removes the cap.
A pulse dampener can hold liquid under pressure after the pump stops. Removing the cap could spray the trapped liquid toward the face and hands of the technician.
WARNING Check Valve Disc Service Sign – Heavy Disc Can Drop On Hands – 8x12 Aluminum
Heavy Disc Can Drop On Hands
CHECK VALVE DISC SERVICE / HEAVY DISC CAN DROP ON HANDS / ISOLATE FLOW AND RESTRAIN DISC / BEFORE REMOVING HINGE PIN
Attach to the valve body access cover or adjacent pipe support, facing the mechanic who pulls the hinge pin.
The disc inside a check valve is heavy and hangs from a hinge pin, so it may drop when the pin is pulled. A hand beneath the disc could be crushed against the valve body.
WARNING Filter Valve Weighted Lever Sign – Lever Can Drop As Pin Releases – 8x12 Aluminum
Lever Can Drop As Pin Releases
FILTER VALVE WEIGHTED LEVER / LEVER CAN DROP AS PIN RELEASES / ISOLATE FLOW AND RESTRAIN LEVER / BEFORE DISCONNECTING VALVE STEM
Fasten to the filter valve frame beside the weighted lever, facing the technician who disconnects the stem.
A weighted lever on a filter valve holds stored weight that is released when the stem pin is removed. The lever could swing down suddenly and strike or pinch the technician.
WARNING Sewer Liner Steam Return Sign – Return Hose Can Release Steam – 8x12 Aluminum
SEWER LINER STEAM RETURN / RETURN HOSE CAN RELEASE STEAM / KEEP CLEAR OF THE HOSE OUTLET / VERIFY COOL AND DEPRESSURIZED / BEFORE DISCONNECTING RETURN HOSE
Place on the sewer liner steam return hose connection or truck panel, facing the operator at the hose outlet.
A steam return hose on a liner truck can still contain steam or hot condensate when it is disconnected. The release could scald hands, arms or face near the outlet.
WARNING Sludge Cake Breaker Shaft Sign – Breaker Teeth Can Catch Hands – 8x12 Aluminum
SLUDGE CAKE BREAKER SHAFT / BREAKER TEETH CAN CATCH HANDS / NO REACHING INTO CAKE DISCHARGE / LOCK OUT BEFORE CLEARING CAKE
Mount on the dewatering press discharge guard beside the cake breaker, facing the operator who clears the discharge.
The shaft teeth on a sludge cake breaker turn through sticky material and can grab a hand reaching in to clear it. The hand could be pulled into the shaft and crushed.
WARNING Storm Pump Guide Rail Bracket Sign – Pump Can Fall If Guide Releases – 8x12 Aluminum
Pump Can Fall If Guide Releases
STORM PUMP GUIDE RAIL BRACKET / PUMP CAN FALL IF GUIDE RELEASES / REMOVE PUMP BEFORE BRACKET WORK / GUARD THE OPEN PUMP WELL
Attach to the pump station railing or the open pump well cover, facing the crew who service the guide rail.
A storm pump rides on its guide rail, so a bracket released while the pump is still in place could let it fall into the well. Workers at the opening could be struck or pulled in.
WARNING Immersion Tank Lid Support Sign – Heavy Lid Can Fall During Repair – 8x12 Aluminum
Heavy Lid Can Fall During Repair
IMMERSION TANK LID SUPPORT / HEAVY LID CAN FALL DURING REPAIR / SECURE LID WITH APPROVED SUPPORT / BEFORE WORKING UNDER OPEN LID
Fasten to the immersion tank frame beside the lid support, facing workers who reach under the lid.
A heavy immersion tank lid is held open by its supports and can fall if they slip or fail during repair. A worker under the lid could have a head, arm or hand crushed.
